title: Finite relative-modular cocycle and resolvent-core Cook checkpoint
question: On the registered finite Q3 edge and square, do the exact ordered relative cocycle, its derivative, its composition law, its same-q resolvent identity and both state-weighted orientations survive every actual prefix, order, time sign, beta value, translated seed and adjoint orientation?
method: Build H_prime=H+B from every actual onsite or Q3 bond prefix and evaluate U(t)=exp(+i t H_prime) exp(-i t H) without importing the primary implementation into the independent lane.

Check the relative intertwining identity, the finite-difference derivative, all declared cocycle composition pairs, and the same-q resolvent difference identity for nonzero imaginary spectral parameters.
Evaluate both B A_z and A_z B, their commutator and the adjoint seed in the two-sided Gibbs weighted rows for beta 1/2 and 1.
Run a hostile reversed-product mutation and require a non-roundoff residual, then compile Lean R385 for the abstract ordered cocycle and scalar resolvent identity.
Keep phase-local BKM control, l1 shell summability, cutoff/source/volume/shape uniformity, the operator domain, direct D/delta-D Cauchy convergence, common alpha and every QFT promotion flag open.
finding: The primary lane passes 3664/3664 assertions, the non-importing independent lane passes 608/608 aggregate assertions, the integrated verifier passes 87/87, and Lean R385 compiles. The grid contains 608 contexts (96 on V=2 and 512 on V=4), 22 prefixes and 10 bond prefixes. Maximum residuals are 2.8751206244079863e-14 for relative intertwining, 1.3568796804866375e-14 for cocycle composition, 2.850589646690371e-10 for the finite-difference derivative, 1.708982179746617e-16 for the resolvent identity and 1.0872551803121098e-14 for unitarity. The maximum ordinary commutator norm is 0.6388765649999403 and the maximum weighted commutator is 0.7980860666930905. The hostile reversed orientation gives residual 0.12803849472459028 above the 1.0e-7 threshold and is rejected. Primary and independent numerical fields agree exactly in the integrated run.
decision_reason: R-385 advances EXP-001227 from a route design to a reproducible finite algebra/interface checkpoint. The ordered cocycle and resolvent bookkeeping survive the declared bounded grid, and the hostile lane demonstrates that product orientation is load-bearing. The nonzero weighted commutator is retained as a diagnostic rather than a smallness claim. No finite table supplies the missing phase-local BKM boundary estimate or l1 shell coefficient, so no thermodynamic, common-alpha or QFT gate closes.

adversarial_review.check: The declared exp(+i t H_prime) exp(-i t H) order is used in both lanes; the reversed product is deliberately mutated and rejected.
Every prefix is rebuilt and the next actual onsite or bond term is used as B; no bulk-difference shortcut or unlisted halo is substituted.
The derivative is checked by a declared central finite difference and compared to the ordered alpha_prime_t(B) U expression; no commuting-B formula is used.
All seeds use nonzero imaginary parameters and the same-q identity is evaluated without commuting q with H.
Both product orientations and both adjoint seeds are retained as two-sided finite Gibbs rows; they are not relabelled point-norm or representation-independent bounds.
The oscillator matrices are finite and bounded. No form-domain, unbounded perturbation or infinite-dimensional Cook theorem is inferred.
The integrated scope firewall keeps shell summability, all uniformities, domain/Cook convergence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A false.

next_action: Derive the actual phase-local BKM boundary estimate for [B,R_z(A)] and its modular derivative on an explicitly invariant form/resolvent core, with constants uniform in source, cutoff, volume and exhaustion shape and with both orientations. If the resulting coefficients are l1-summable, integrate the relative cocycle by Cook to obtain direct D and delta-D Cauchy convergence; otherwise record the precise route-specific obstruction and retire only this route.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite relative-modular cocycle checkpoint only. It proves no phase-local BKM estimate, shell summability, uniformity, domain embedding, direct Cook limit, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A.
no_overclaim: Finite ordered identities and matching weighted rows on two bounded Q3 truncations do not establish an infinite-volume dynamics or a QFT result. The nonzero commutator values are diagnostics, not convergence bounds.
